newsitem.title: GERMANY: 17,000 evacuated in German town as WW2 bomb found.
newsitem.headline: 17,000 evacuated in German town as WW2 bomb found.

text.p: About 17,000 people were evacuated from a town in eastern Germany on Wednesday as munitions experts moved in to defuse an Allied bomb from World War Two buried beneath a school.
Two major highways, the railway line and the river Havel in Oranienburg were sealed off to allow bomb experts to defuse the 500 kg (1,100 lb) bomb, a spokeswoman for the local authorities said.
Bomb experts pinpointed the U.S. bomb, buried three and a half metres (yards) under the school's grounds, after examining World War Two aerial photographs.

The spokeswoman said 47 such bombs had been found in the area since 1990 and it was being combed for more. Oranienburg, north of Berlin, was particularly heavily bombed because it had two armaments factories.
